name: release-preflight
cmd: set -euo pipefail; OUT=$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR; bun install --frozen-lockfile > "$OUT/install.log" 2>&1; bun scripts/gen-lean-library.ts > "$OUT/library-gen.log" 2>&1; bunx tsc -p research/bapa/tsconfig.release.json > "$OUT/types.log" 2>&1; for c in p1 p2 p3; do bunx tsc -p "research/bapa/tsconfig.$c.json" > "$OUT/types-$c.log" 2>&1; done; bun test --timeout 120000 research/protocols/ic3syn/sized-p1.test.ts research/bapa/consensus-sized.test.ts research/bapa/p3-sized.test.ts > "$OUT/ports.log" 2>&1; bunx @commitlint/cli --config research/egraph/historical/commitlint.config.cjs < research/bapa/release-integration-commit.txt > "$OUT/commitlint.log" 2>&1
